lines.text: The whole congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting, though seven tribes had no inheritance.
Joshua told them to appoint three men from each tribe to survey the land, and he would cast lots in Gilgal.
The Levites received no portion, because their inheritance was the priesthood of the LORD.
The men returned with a document to Joshua, and the first lot came up for the tribe of Judah.
The Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun the city of Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, as he requested.
